## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] UI or design system
- [ ] API contract
- [ ] Authorization model
- [ ] Tests or CI
- [ ] Refactor

## Model impact

Does this change any IAM, STS, S3, KMS, transition, or reporting assumption? If yes, link the updated documentation.

## Verification

- [ ] `cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `cd frontend && npm run build`
- [ ] Added or updated tests for security-critical behavior
- [ ] Checked loading, empty, error, and populated states for UI changes
- [ ] Confirmed no credentials, tokens, or sensitive data are included

## Screenshots

Include before and after images for visible interface changes.

## Notes

Call out known limitations or follow-up work.
